# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want integration tests and static-analysis quality gates across the core services, so that regressions are caught before deploy, not after

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** integration tests and static-analysis quality gates across the core services
**So that** regressions are caught before deploy, not after

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a request crossing the gateway to movie, user or actor, when the
      integration suites run, then routing, auth, error propagation, circuit
      breaking and rate limiting all hold (`GatewayIntegrationTest`, #19)
- [x] Given a running stack, when the full user journeys and the Postman
      collection run against it, then both pass end to end (`FullStackJourneyIT`
      and `infrastructure/docker/smoke-test.sh`, run nightly by
      `.github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml`, #19)
- [x] Given a push to `main`, when SonarQube analysis runs, then the quality
      gate passes with no open bug, vulnerability or code smell (the "SonarQube
      analysis" step in `.github/workflows/backend-ci.yml`, #20)
- [x] Given any push, when the build runs, then line coverage stays at or above
      80% in every module except media-service
      (`./gradlew jacocoTestCoverageVerification`, #20)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)
